summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Filtering by a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied and contains <a category with at least two products> as well as products from at least one other category.
steps: Note the products shown in the unfiltered catalogue.
Select the category filter <a category with at least two products>.
cases.expected: Only products belonging to the selected category appear in the list; products from other categories are not shown.

cases.title: Filtering by two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied and contains products in <first category> and in <second category>, plus products in at least one further category.
steps: Additionally select the category filter <second category>.
cases.expected: Products from both selected categories appear in the list; products from categories that are not selected are not shown.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied and contains <a category and a brand that share at least one product>, plus products of that brand in another category and products of other brands in the same category.
steps: Select the category filter <the chosen category>.
Select the brand filter <the chosen brand>.
cases.expected: Only products that belong to the selected category and are of the selected brand appear; products matching only the category or only the brand are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters returns the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied and contains products in several categories and of several brands.
steps: Note the products shown in the unfiltered catalogue.
Select <a category filter> and <a brand filter> and confirm the list is narrowed down.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the unfiltered catalogue noted in step 1.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied and contains <a category and a brand that have no product in common>.
steps: Select the category filter <the chosen category>.
Select the brand filter <the chosen brand that has no product in that category>.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since only products matching both the category and the brand may appear. The exact wording or appearance of any empty-result message is not specified in the story.
